message: 死線の遭遇

name: Synn
message: 「I was thinking about making this the venue for the Holy Night Festival... What do you think?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The view's great here, and it looks like we could pull off all sorts of things」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm all for it--♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Celebrating the Holy Night while watching shooting stars streak across the night sky... How wonderful\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「You're quite the romantic, Misa-chan」

name: Azel
message: 「This place is...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「N-Nothing...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, Azel-san! Let's explore every nook and cranny~」

name: Azel
message: 「A-Ah!」

name: Ria
message: 「Azel-san... has really changed, hasn't he」

name: Synn
message: 「He's still just as cold to me as ever, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「It's Sakura-kun we're talking about, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, what's that supposed to mean?」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan is a special friend to him, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd like to get closer to him too, though」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't just let a remark like that slide!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Especially when you already have a girl like Lolo-chan right by your side!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't mean it like that!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Cheating is a no-no~」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, that's not--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hm, what's wrong?」
What is this ominous presence... I can feel a strong will, almost as if someone is calling out to me.
A distinct signal, unlike what I've occasionally sensed up until now.

name: Synn
message: 「Who is it...」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun...?」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sorry. Did I make you mad...?」

name: Synn
message: 「No... it's not that...」
And what's more, it's coming from the direction Lolotte and the others headed.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to go explore a bit too!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, where are you going」

name: Synn
message: 「Where's Lolotte... where's Azel...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We're gonna decorate this tower to perfection too~~」

name: Azel
message: 「Something as massive as this... How do you propose we do that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's what we're going to figure out together starting now!」

name: Azel
message: 「I see」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Lolotte! Azel!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hah, hah, thank goodness... Looks like you're both safe」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's the matter, rushing over in such a panic?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nothing... I just had a bad feeling coming from this direction」

name: Azel
message: 「A bad feeling, you say...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's no problem at all」

name: Synn
message: 「That's strange... Even though it felt much clearer than usual」

name: Azel
message: 「What did you say...?」

name: Bylous
message: 「You have fallen.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're...」

name: Azel
message: 「Bylous...!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san, Bylous is...」
Greasy sweat oozed from his forehead. Azel bit down hard on his lip, his expression betraying deep remorse.

name: Bylous
message: 「To think you would lose sight of your true purpose and indulge in playing friends.」

name: Azel
message: 「Sh-Shut up!!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Are you not the very definition of a fallen angel?」
He knows that Azel is an angel...?
Speaking of Bylous, Pasta had mentioned that name once before.
Bylous... Judging by his appearance, not only is he clearly not a staff member, he carries an ominous air about him.
Yet judging from Azel's reaction, his demeanor doesn't seem like that of an ally at all.

name: Synn
message: 「Who on earth are you...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hold on, Bylous-san!! How could you say such a terrible thing to Azel-san!!」

name: Azel
message: 「St-Stop!」
Azel hurriedly stepped in to stop Lolotte, who had rushed ahead to protest on pure reflex.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Take that back!! Azel-san is no fallen angel--」

name: Bylous
message: 「Demon Lord.」
He even knows that I'm the Demon Lord!?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please listen to me!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Stop it!! Stay out of this!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, calm down」
Bylous paid no mind whatsoever to Lolotte's state.
However, just as Azel said, there's an atmosphere suggesting that getting involved with him won't end well.
He isn't even radiating bloodlust, so why am I breaking out in a cold sweat?

name: Bylous
message: 「When will you awaken as the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「How do you know that I'm the Demon Lord?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Would sacrificing your comrade do the trick?」
For the first time, Bylous's gaze shifts toward Lolotte.
He doesn't seem to have the slightest intention of listening to my question.
Glared at with icy eyes, Lolotte loses all bravado and cowers.
It's no wonder.
Eyes of solitude--the cold, composed gaze possessed only by one who has crossed the line between life and death countless times.
I step in front of Lolotte, blocking Bylous's line of sight.
Lolotte hides behind my back, shrinking away.

name: Synn
message: 「If you do something like that--」

name: Azel
message: 「Synn Sakura, that's enough」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」

name: Azel
message: 「Exchanging any more words with him is pointless」

name: Bylous
message: 「Hmph. Premature though it may be, to think your power is only at this level」
Irritation shows in Bylous's tone.

name: Bylous
message: 「What a buzzkill. You've disappointed me, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't fall for his provocation!! As you are now, he's no opponent you can defeat!!」
Faced with Azel's anguished cry, I'm forced to realize for the very first time that I was merely putting on a brave front.
Formidable energy overflows from Bylous, overwhelming me with sheer pressure.
It is magical power on a completely different scale from the Seven Demon Generals I've fought in the past.
Being the King of the Demons is, after all, nothing more than a matter of innate aptitude.
In contrast, this Bylous has the eyes of someone who has overcome countless grueling trials.
There is no way hastily acquired power could ever match a great blade forged and honed to perfection.

name: Bylous
message: 「Whether now or later, looking at you like this, it's clear you don't amount to much」
Confronted with this confidence, I feel like I'm about to be crushed.
Still, if I don't brace myself, my precious friends...... Lolotte and Azel will be put in danger!!

name: Synn
message: 「Even so」

name: Azel
message: 「Enough...... That's enough......」
Azel speaks in a voice utterly drained of strength.
The instant that voice reaches my ears, all will to fight vanishes from me.
The relief carried in that noble voice makes me realize that Azel is an angel, just like Lolotte.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, you're......」
With an expression as though suppressing all emotion, Azel turns back toward Bylous.

name: Azel
message: 「Both your hopes and mine have been dashed. There is no longer any reason or need to linger in the Human World. Leave at once.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Azel
message: 「If you want a replacement for the Demon Lord, you have no business here.」
Bylous casts a silent glance at Azel and vanishes from the spot in an instant.

name: Synn
message: 「What the heck was that......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「P-President......!」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you two unharmed?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah...... Thanks, Azel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san...... Facing someone that terrifying......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really are amazing, Azel-san!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so......」
Azel smiles faintly.

name: Azel
message: 「However, I am a traitor.」

name: Azel
message: 「I intended to take advantage of Re-Crea. Together with Bylous.」

name: Azel
message: 「That librarian named Melilot mentioned it, didn't she? Those who make their move amidst the chaos of Re-Crea」

name: Azel
message: 「That was us......」

name: Synn
message: 「Why would Bylous...?」

name: Azel
message: 「They say the Demon Lord gains immense power in response to the Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「Me?」

name: Azel
message: 「Bylous must have heard that rumor. What his true goal is, I do not know...」
If so, did Bylous leave because he was disappointed in my power?

name: Azel
message: 「I used Bylous. Even so, there was something that had to be done」

name: Azel
message: 「However, that will... bring about many sacrifices...」

name: Azel
message: 「Once those sacrifices are made, what will even be left...?」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't intend to do anything anymore, Azel. That's what you're saying, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes... I no longer... have it in me...」

name: Azel
message: 「That is why... I will... confess everything... My... my mission is--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's okay, Azel-san」

name: Azel
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't have to force yourself to say it. I understand even if you don't」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How you've been... suffering all this time, Azel-san」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All alone, this whole time...」

name: Azel
message: 「Even so, it does not change the fact that I betrayed you all!!」
As Azel vents his lingering anguish, Lolotte opens her arms wide.
And then, she wraps him in a soft, gentle, and warm embrace.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so... isn't it fine now? After all, you protected us, Azel-san...」

name: Azel
message: 「That alone... that alone is not...」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to worry about it. Nobody thinks you're a traitor. We've always been comrades, haven't we?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you trust us, Azel-san, then all we have to do is trust you in return」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Azel
message: 「Urgh... ugh...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So it is all right now... For now, it is... all right...」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... uu... ugh... uuu... ugh!!」
Keeping a literally angelic smile on her face, Lolotte firmly embraced Azel's sorrow.
Together with Azel, who has regained his composure, we head to the Student Council room.
And then, he confesses everything that has happened up until now to everyone.

name: Azel
message: 「I am... truly sorry.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa!! Azel bowed his head!?

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, stop that... You're throwing me off my rhythm.」

name: Ria
message: 「Azel-san...」

name: Helena
message: 「The fact that you kept it a secret all this time means you had your reasons, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「But now... there's no longer any need to keep it a secret. Is that what this means?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes. I will tell you everything I know without hiding anything.」

name: Helena
message: 「I see... Then, the fun things, the happy things, the sad things, and the painful things--」

name: Helena
message: 「From now on, you're going to tell us everything properly. That's an order from the Chairwoman ♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Is that clear?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Understood.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Isn't that wonderful, Azel-san!」

name: Azel
message: 「Thank you... Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You no longer have to worry all by yourself, Azel-san.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because you have so many people by your side who care so deeply for you!!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Yeah.」
Is Azel still unable to shake off the mistakes of his past?
Even so, continuing to reach out to him without giving up is surely something only Lolotte can do.
To bring out his true smile, we have no choice but to take our time slowly.

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay. Because we're right here beside you.」
If we can become Azel's support, we'll definitely be able to spend a sparkling school life together from here on out!!
